findings.title: Changing the default delta key on GCS can break delta pipelines saved before this change
findings.body: Before this change, every `read_storage(..., delta=True)` used the delta key `(file.path, file.etag, file.version)`. With this change, the default on GCS becomes `(file.path, file.version)` with `delta_compare="file.size"`. Result datasets saved by earlier GCS delta runs were keyed on the old key. The existing test above (`pytest.raises(DataChainParamsError, match="change delta key")`) shows that delta refuses to run when the key differs from the previous version's key. If that check covers this case, the first delta run after upgrading fails for every existing GCS pipeline that uses the defaults. If it does not, the old and new keys still don't match, which can cause a full reprocess or wrong matching. I could not see where the previous key is stored or compared. Fix: use the new default only when the previous result version was saved with it, or accept the old default key as compatible. Also add a test that runs a GCS delta pipeline saved with the old default key.
